prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opaque settlement-panel header illustration for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game; one separate image, 1536x640 pixels, very wide 12:5 landscape composition.
Input images: Image 1 (site-city.png) and Image 2 (site-mill.png) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: weathered masonry and timber, broad-brush black ink contours and hatching, muted earthy wash, rugged hand-drawn materials. Do not reproduce their isolated map-icon composition or transparent backgrounds.
Primary request: Kamenny Brod, a walled river town market square beside a stone ford. Depict modest market stalls with awnings, a freestanding notice board with blank unmarked parchment shapes, and a timber watch post; show the shallow rocky river ford connecting to the town gate and enclosing stone walls.
Composition/framing: wide three-quarter elevated view into the square and river edge; clear readable stalls, notice board, watch post and ford in the middle of the frame. Full-bleed continuous landscape and sky, no borders, no isolated diorama. Keep all key features within the central wide horizontal band so the picture remains readable as a short panel header.
Lighting/mood: late autumn, overcast daylight, somber dark fantasy grounded in practical rural medieval construction.
Style/medium: broad expressive black ink brush lines, irregular hand-hatched shadows, muted earthy watercolor wash; ochre, weathered brown, stone gray and desaturated slate river. Match both references' hand-worked material character, not glossy photorealism or 3D rendering.
Constraints: fully opaque image edge to edge. No people in the foreground, preferably no people anywhere. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, symbols, signatures or watermarks, including on the notice board. Original setting; do not imitate any existing game or artist.
model: image_gen (built-in; underlying model identifier not exposed)
